title: Khati Sha the Twisted
summary: Break the warder and arcanist defenses before facing Khati Sha.
overview: Break the warder and arcanist defenses before facing Khati Sha.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Complete the warder and chanting sequence; Khati Sha is the final stage of the event.
Clear the disruptive minions and distinguish the false arcanist from the true arcanists.
Defeat the death guards before progressing the arcanist stage.
Keep Khati Sha in his encounter area and be ready to control returning guards.
